# WikiMem

> Self-improving memory for agents: ingest anything, query everything. A local-first Markdown wiki with a command line (`wikimem`), an MCP server (`wikimem-mcp`, 19 tools), three skills and a Claude Code plugin. Its agent employee is Codex.

WikiMem turns files, links and connected apps into linked wiki pages, answers questions from them with citations, and scores and improves its own pages with an observer loop. Every vault is a folder of Markdown files, a git repository and an Obsidian vault.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): what it does, every tool and how to call it, what not to do
- [README.md](README.md): install from any coding agent, quick start, how it works
- [SOUL.md](identity/SOUL.md): Codex, the agent employee behind WikiMem: persona, boundaries, operating model

## Skills

- [wikimem](skills/wikimem/SKILL.md): ingest, search, ask, sync a connector, or expose a vault over MCP
- [wikimem-ingest-pipeline](skills/wikimem-ingest-pipeline/SKILL.md): turn files, folders or URLs into linted, linked pages, incrementally
- [wikimem-observer](skills/wikimem-observer/SKILL.md): score every page, find weak and missing pages, improve a budget-capped set

## MCP tools

- [MCP server over stdio](src/mcp-server.ts): wikimem_search, wikimem_read, wikimem_list, wikimem_status, wikimem_ask, wikimem_ingest, wikimem_ingest_url, wikimem_pipeline, wikimem_scrape, wikimem_observe, wikimem_run_observer, wikimem_get_report, wikimem_improve, wikimem_lint, wikimem_connectors, wikimem_list_connectors, wikimem_connect, wikimem_sync, wikimem_preview
- [MCP over HTTP with OAuth 2.1](src/mcp/http-server.ts): the same tools at `/mcp` when `wikimem serve` runs
- [Claude Code plugin](.claude-plugin/plugin.json): skills, sub-agents, a vault hook and the MCP server in one install
- [A2A agent card](.well-known/agent-card.json): name, description and skills for agent-to-agent discovery
